description: This file defines a class-based handler for processing OpenAI chat completion messages, including mechanisms to extract text, images, and tool calls from input and output messages and apply guardrails to ensure compliance or moderation. It includes methods for handling standard responses, streaming responses, and transforming responses in place when guardrails modify the content.

classes.name: OpenAIChatCompletionsHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing OpenAI chat completions messages with support for guardrails, including processing input messages, output responses, streaming responses, and applying modifications based on guardrail responses.
